run_DETR_training: run the DETR transformer detector training script with configurable backbone, epochs, and learning rate
run_DETR_evaluation: run the DETR model evaluation on a validation dataset and save COCO bbox results
run_DETR_distributed_training: run multi-GPU distributed DETR training across multiple machines using torch multiprocessing
run_DETR_frozen_weights: run DETR training with frozen pretrained weights to train only the segmentation mask head
run_DETR_checkpoint_resume: resume DETR training from a saved checkpoint restoring model, optimizer, and scheduler state
